description: Discover, quote, and execute crypto swaps across 14 CEXes and 20+ DEXes via HoudiniSwap, with x402 pay-per-call (USDC on Base — no signup).

x402_private_key.title: x402 wallet private key
x402_private_key.description: Required for any data. The API is pay-per-call: every request costs a fraction of a cent in USDC on Base, paid from this wallet. Paste the private key of a wallet funded with USDC on Base — MetaMask's exported key works with or without the 0x prefix. Without a key every request returns 402.
